name: ledger
description: The record of orchestrated work: runs of units and tasks, the subagents spawned for them, each gate's verdict and the findings reviewers report, summed up in the status line while there is something to say. It can follow a superpowers plan document as its input. Run /ledger.

followPlans.title: Follow superpowers plans
followPlans.description: Read a plan saved under docs/superpowers/plans as a run by itself: its tasks from the document's Task headings, their progress from its checkboxes, read again each time the document changes. Off, a run is only what the agent records.

tickPlans.title: Tick finished tasks in the plan
tickPlans.description: When a task of a followed plan is marked done, tick the checkboxes under it that were missed. Only an open box under a done task is changed. Off, /ledger tick does it when asked.
